name: Compromise Software Supply Chain
reported_behavior: Trojanized Orion software updates delivered SUNBURST.
proposed_hunt: Correlate software inventory, update provenance and unusual child processes.

name: PowerShell
reported_behavior: PowerShell supported post-compromise commands and task operations.
project_application: Weeks 5-7 contain the historical Windows PowerShell observations.
proposed_hunt: Retain command lines, script-block logs when enabled and process ancestry.

name: Windows Command Shell
reported_behavior: cmd.exe executed commands on remote machines.
project_application: Historical cmd control is not validation of remote execution.
proposed_hunt: Join remote authentication to process creation; distinguish administrative jobs.

name: Scheduled Task
reported_behavior: Existing scheduled tasks were temporarily modified, then restored.
project_application: In the Week 8 Windows run c5dff010b214, the loader registered a new task with a logon trigger (Security 4698, record 507). It requested a manual start with schtasks.exe /run (4688, record 508). The marker action (4688, record 509) wrote the run ID. The loader then deleted the task (4699, record 524). Execution at a subsequent logon, modification and restoration of an existing task, and privilege escalation remain untested.
proposed_hunt: Compare task definitions over time and correlate registration with payload execution.

name: Credentials from Web Browsers
reported_behavior: RDP Bitmap Cache reconstruction showed a Chrome export of saved passwords to plaintext CSV (CrowdStrike figure 4).
project_application: Mock JSON is not a browser credential store or DPAPI validation.
proposed_hunt: Monitor unusual access/export involving browser credential stores with suitable EDR telemetry.

name: Steal Web Session Cookie
reported_behavior: Shellbags showed Chrome and DPAPI directory navigation. Falcon identified the Cookie Editor extension used in the reported session reuse (figures 2–3).
project_application: Fake cookies were archived; no valid session or cookie theft was tested.
proposed_hunt: Correlate sensitive browser-file access with identity and session anomalies.

name: Data from Local System
reported_behavior: Volexity recorded a 7-Zip command naming the exported local file C:\Temp\b.pst as its input on the OWA server.
project_application: The lab has synthetic file opens and archive member checks. The reported Exchange collection is CTI only.
proposed_hunt: Correlate the PST export and a subsequent ReadData event for the PST with the 7-Zip process, then look separately for staging and a web request.

name: Archive via Utility
reported_behavior: 7-Zip created password-protected archives, sometimes split into parts.
project_application: Week 9 exercised Linux tar/gzip and Windows tar.exe on synthetic files.
proposed_hunt: Review archiver command lines and source paths; correlate outputs and later egress.

name: Remote Data Staging
reported_behavior: Archives were staged on a victim OWA server.
project_application: Local out/ artifacts do not demonstrate remote staging.
proposed_hunt: Join remote file writes, server role and authentication context.

name: Exfiltration Over Asymmetric Encrypted Non-C2 Protocol
reported_behavior: MITRE C0024 maps retrieval of a staged OWA archive over HTTPS to T1048.002. Volexity shows the 7-Zip command that created Redir.png and gives an illustrative HTTPS URL.
project_application: The lab collected local archive telemetry. Volexity publishes no request log for the illustrated URL.
proposed_hunt: Check IIS or reverse-proxy logs for the staged URI, request time, response status and bytes served. Correlate them with creation time and archive size.
